D: An undersized racehorse and a team of broken men become a symbol of hope during the Depression.
P: Serve the snacks before the big match race against War Admiral.
S: Roasted peanuts in the shell and crackers with cheese, a racetrack crowd snack. Tip 500g roasted peanuts in the shell into a bowl with a second bowl for shells.
Apple and carrot sticks with peanut butter, the treats a racehorse would choose. Slice 3 apples and cut 3 carrots into sticks.
M: Glazed meatloaf with mash, a meal that stretches a little further. Mix 800g beef mince with a diced onion, 1 egg and breadcrumbs.
W: Apple pie with cream. Slice 5 green apples and toss with sugar and cinnamon. Fill a pastry case, top with pastry and bake at 190C for 45 minutes.
K: Iced tea with lemon. Steep 4 tea bags in 1L boiling water, chill and serve over ice with lemon slices.

s.how: Tip 500g roasted peanuts in the shell into a bowl with a second bowl for shells. Arrange 200g crackers and 150g cheddar on a board beside them.
Slice 3 apples and cut 3 carrots into sticks. Serve with 200g peanut butter for dipping. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.how: Mix 800g beef mince with a diced onion, 1 egg and breadcrumbs. Press into a tin, glaze with tomato sauce and bake at 180C for 1 hour. Serve with mash from 800g potatoes.

w.how: Slice 5 green apples and toss with sugar and cinnamon. Fill a pastry case, top with pastry and bake at 190C for 45 minutes. Serve with cream.

d.how: Steep 4 tea bags in 1L boiling water, chill and serve over ice with lemon slices. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
